a.lede: A draft UK government list of AI best practices has reminded people they don't need to thank their chatbot for its work in an attempt to use it more efficiently.
a.title: UK government tells staff to stop thanking AI chatbots

b.lede: Speaking with an AI chatbot can be a little awkward, but companies like Google and OpenAI are working on fixing that.
b.title: Gemini Live vs. ChatGPT Voice: Which AI offers a more natural conversation?
